root_idea.summary: The root centers on what comes after something else: succession, following, replacement, consequence, and requital. A second established branch denotes elevation, hardness, and difficulty.
root_idea.development: The succession sense extends from a follower or later stage to an outcome, recompense, or punishment. The separate elevation-and-hardness branch yields the mountain pass, projecting rock, reinforcing material, and the eagle.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Plural active participle is presented under the supported singular citation form مُعَقِّب.

senses.definition: To turn back, return, or look back after going away.
senses.usage_conditions: In the two Quran occurrences, the verb is used of turning back or looking behind oneself; voice and aspect vary by context but do not create separate lexical senses.

senses.definition: To requite or retaliate against someone; to punish in response to an injury, with equivalent measure.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic construction may describe retaliation, punishment, or requital, including a passive counterpart for undergoing such treatment. These are contextual realizations of the same responsive action.

senses.definition: To cause something to follow as a consequence; to bring upon someone a resulting condition or punishment.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic use presents a consequence—hypocrisy—as following from a prior act and its moral failure.

senses.definition: The final outcome, end, or consequence of an affair.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran uses the noun for an eventual result that may be good or bad. With expressions such as لِلْمُتَّقِينَ it denotes the good or rewarded end; in possessive constructions it can denote a disastrous outcome.

senses.definition: A steep or difficult mountain path; figuratively, a hard undertaking.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic expression presents difficulty as an ascent or pass that must be entered and overcome.

senses.definition: The heel, the rear part of the foot.
senses.usage_conditions: The plural form أَعْقَاب and the dual عَقِبَيْ occur in Quranic expressions for turning back or retreating on one's heels.

senses.definition: Offspring or descendants who remain after a person.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression فِي عَقِبِهِ, the term denotes continuing descendants rather than the physical heel.

senses.definition: Punishment, penalty, or retribution inflicted in response to wrongdoing.
senses.usage_conditions: The noun denotes the punitive consequence itself; contextual translations range from punishment and penalty to retribution.

senses.definition: The final consequence, outcome, or end, especially the resulting recompense.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence the term occurs in a comparison of recompense and final consequence.

senses.definition: The ultimate outcome, requital, or final attainment, especially a favorable reward.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic contexts chiefly present the good final result or recompense of faithful conduct; the term can also describe the eventual consequence more generally.

senses.definition: One who follows after another; successive or alternating followers, including the guardian angels who succeed one another.
senses.usage_conditions: The plural مُعَقِّبَات in the Quran denotes successive angelic guardians. The singular form is also used in the construction لَا مُعَقِّبَ لِحُكْمِهِ, where the following-up becomes an attempt to reverse or repel a decree.

senses.definition: One who follows up, challenges, or can reverse a judgment.
senses.usage_conditions: In لَا مُعَقِّبَ لِحُكْمِهِ, the term means that no one can repel, overturn, or call the decree to account.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To come after, follow, succeed, or take the place of another person or thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The branch includes close following, succession, replacement, and one event or person coming after another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To alternate or take turns with another in an action, position, or use of an object.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of riders, partners in an action, alternating bodily support, and interchangeable forms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek evil against someone, including committing adultery with his wife or defaming him behind his back.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are specialized Classical constructions, distinct from ordinary succession and from Quranic punishment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To marry a woman after her former husband.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized construction meaning to succeed a previous husband in relation to the woman.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For whiteness or hoariness to follow and replace the blackness of the hair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The meaning is used of the succession of a later condition to an earlier one.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a horse to perform a run after another run, or to recover and make a subsequent run.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may denote the subsequent run itself or the capacity for repeated running.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For camels to move from one place to another while pasturing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A pastoral usage concerning changing grazing places.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An adverse consequence or liability that subsequently falls upon someone, especially damage in merchandise.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of responsibility for a defect or harmful result discovered after a transaction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take or receive something in exchange, as a substitute, equivalent, or requital for another thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may denote taking an equivalent from someone, receiving compensation, or obtaining spoil as a requital.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek or pursue wealth or another desired thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general Classical use of the Form I verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bind or reinforce an object with the tough white sinew called عَقَب.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of binding earrings, bows, arrows, and similar objects with this tendon material.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To line or reinforce a well with stones, pottery, or material placed behind or between its courses.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical well-construction usage involving successive backing or reinforcement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A return or going back after departure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use of the verbal noun; it is distinct from the physical heel and from a final outcome.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To do something again after doing it once, or to follow one undertaking with another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of repeated prayers, repeated expeditions, and successive acts.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remain after prayer for supplication or to perform a subsequent supererogatory prayer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A ritual and devotional construction, including waiting in one's place after an obligatory prayer.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A subsequent qualification or exception added after an act or statement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the expression concerning charity, it denotes following a gift with a condition or exception.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To delay or defer payment of another person's due.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive construction concerning postponement of a debt or entitlement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To consider the consequence, end, issue, or result of an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form II usage may involve looking again at an affair or repeatedly considering its outcome.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make repeated efforts or go repeatedly to and fro in pursuit of an objective.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of persistent striving in an affair or in the pursuit of distinction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a plant to become slender and yellow as it reaches the season of drying.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical usage describing a late stage before complete desiccation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To plane or smooth a stone used in a well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical Form II use concerning a stone called عُقَاب.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To interchange two things or make them replaceable one for the other.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction عَاقَبَ بَيْنَ الشَّيْئَيْنِ includes alternation between sounds or other forms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a mare to be made to perform run after run.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized equine usage distinct from punitive requital.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make one person take another's place or yield a position so that the other may act in turn.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially when one dismounts so another can ride, and more generally of transfer of a role.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For an affliction or visitation to return at intervals.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV intransitive use describing recurring insanity or a similar visitation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a man to die and leave offspring.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Intransitive; the lexical focus is the succession of descendants after the deceased.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To return from evil to good.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized intransitive Form IV usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To set upon someone and beat him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized transitive construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a riding camel to become jaded or fatigued.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the resulting condition of the mount.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The remains of food or broth left adhering to the bottom of a cooking pot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also the small remainder returned with a borrowed pot.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To repent of an affair or action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form V usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To investigate information repeatedly, ask again, or examine a report critically.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb may denote repeated inquiry, searching after information, or looking for grounds to question it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To find fault with, impugn, or expose a person's error or concealed failing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in criticism of a person, judgment, saying, or opinion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To follow another's footsteps.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported Form X usage attributed to a lexical authority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To experience or receive something subsequently as the consequence of an act.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of experiencing repentance, good, or another result after an action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To withhold, detain, confine, or imprison someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes retaining merchandise until payment and detaining a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The latter part, last stage, or end of a period or affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Classical expressions use the word for the end of a month, the remaining part of an illness, or a state following another state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The strap of a sandal that embraces the heel, or the lower pivot of a door.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Two concrete extensions of the rear or supporting part.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing or person that follows another, including an alternating partner.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of sequences in time, alternating night and day, and actions performed turn by turn.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A reply or further response to a statement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the proverb about interrupted speech, the term means an available answer.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A child or descendants remaining after a man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This broader Classical branch includes discussion of male offspring and descendants; its Quranic occurrence is separately represented under the Quranic noun sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mark, trace, impress, characteristic, or outward sign of a quality.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the visible mark of generosity, manliness, beauty, or a comparable characteristic.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The return or reappearance of the moon after setting or changing phase; by extension, an event occurring at a recurring lunar interval.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sources report differing accounts of the relevant monthly or yearly interval.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A variegated or figured cloth used for covering a camel litter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A textile term with a reported consonantal variant.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The last surviving member or remainder of a group.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the final remaining person among a lineage or group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A turn or allotted period during which an action is performed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of taking turns riding, watering camels, praying, or carrying out another duty.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The place on a riding animal where a person mounts during his turn.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized travel usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A measured stage or distance of travel, including a distance of two leagues.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distance term associated with successive halting places or stages.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The interval between a bird's ascent and descent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized term for a bird's successive movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A substitute or thing given in exchange for another, including a ransom or replacement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of receiving a substitute for a captive or another exchanged object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Food or pasture taken after an earlier kind of food or pasture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of camels changing between kinds of plants and of sweetmeat eaten after the main meal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A traditional appellation for a cooking pot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic naming expression rather than a productive lexical sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A difficulty or adverse experience resulting from an action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sources preserve a spelling and lexical attribution issue in this expression; the reported sense is difficulty experienced as a consequence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A later changed condition following an earlier one, especially a reversion from harmful conduct.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Appears in a proverbial description of changing through weakness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Obscure or unintelligible speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical variant is explicitly connected with an expression for obscure language.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rough, coarse, or rude man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical attribution is reported with doubt about the form's correctness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An eagle, a predatory bird; by extension, a bird or object likened to it for force, swiftness, or appearance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The entry includes the bird itself, an eagle with powerful talons, and figurative applications to a black she-camel and a banner.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The northern constellation Aquila.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical astronomical extension of the eagle name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A banner or standard, especially a large military banner.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is named by resemblance to the eagle; it can also denote the Prophet's banner.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A black she-camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative animal designation based on resemblance to the eagle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A projecting rock in a well or mountain, including a step-like ascent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The well usage includes a rock that can damage a bucket or support the water-drawer; the mountain usage denotes a projecting rocky stair or ascent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hill or anything elevated that is not especially long or tall.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general topographical extension of the elevation branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A channel carrying water to a trough or tank.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical hydraulic term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An almond-like growth arising in the leg of an animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small thread used to fasten the ring of an earring.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical object term associated with binding and fastening.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A garment of the type called بُرْد.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare lexical attribution.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A ploughshare.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare lexical attribution reported through a secondary authority within the entry.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Two pieces of wood between which a person is stretched for flogging or crucifixion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plural expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Punishment or chastisement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the ordinary Classical noun for punishment; its punitive branch is kept distinct from the Quranic form عِقَاب while remaining semantically related.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Detention, confinement, or imprisonment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A legal or disciplinary extension in which punishment consists of confinement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A certain small bird, possibly an eaglet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The identification is lexical but the zoological identification is uncertain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who comes after or succeeds another; a successor in goodness, office, or leadership.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may describe the last in a sequence, a successor to a chief, or a person who follows another in beneficence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Camels that alternate between kinds of pasture or repeatedly return between watering and their resting place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized pastoral adjective and plural usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A chief, lord, or successor to a chief or lord.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A social and political extension of the successor sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Streaks or bands arranged one behind another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural descriptive usage, including streaks of fat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pottery or small pieces placed between courses of bricks in a well to strengthen the casing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical well-building usage, distinct from the ordinary plural of heel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A catchword written at the bottom of a page.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Explicitly identified as a later or modern technical word.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One whose state is changed by a succeeding condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participial description of successive change of condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A star that rises after another star and marks a change of turn for travelers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical astronomical and travel usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A skilled driver or a camel ridden by different persons in turns.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Two specialized nominal uses connected with managing or sharing successive turns.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman's head covering that takes the place of another garment, or an earring.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Distinct object names preserved under the same lexical form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One made to leave a vintner's shop when a more important person enters.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized social idiom involving displacement by a later arrival.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Arriving at the end or near the end of the day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A temporal participial use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An arrow returned repeatedly into the game container, whose prize is hoped for.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized term from the game of maysir.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A fat slaughtered camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized phrase concerning the meat or body of a slaughtered camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Repeated devotional utterances performed after the ordinary prayer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A ritual term for successive repetitions of praise and glorification.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who repeatedly pursues a right, demands restitution, or seeks to recover property taken from him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The agent may be a wronged person pursuing his due; a reported alternative analysis treats the word as the debtor who delays payment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man who descends into a well to raise a projecting stone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized occupational use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman who habitually gives birth to a male after a female.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of a recurring birth sequence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A chamber in which raisins are placed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare technical or architectural use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A palm tree that bears fruit one year and fails to bear the next.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical use of alternating production.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A revenger of blood who obtains retaliation for a slain person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A social and legal extension of requital, distinct from the Quranic Form III verb entry.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The male of the partridge, sand-grouse, or related game bird; one interpretation identifies it with an eagle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The zoological identification is disputed in the lexical discussion; the bird name is distinct from the foreign proper name Yaʿqūb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The name of a sect of the Khawarij and of a Christian sect associated with Jacobus Baradaeus.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proper-name-derived sectarian designation.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Exchange/requital and the Quranic Form III reading.
Quranic turning back and post-prayer waiting.
Causing a consequence, including the Quranic usage.
Setting upon someone to beat him.
End and consequence branch, including Quran-attested synonyms.
Night and day succeeding each other.
Singulative relation to the mountain-path term.
Well worker handling a projecting stone.
The cited bird identification is disputed between partridge and eagle.

cautions: The classical entry for يَعْقُوب distinguishes the Arabic bird name from the foreign proper name and reports disagreement about which bird is intended.
Some Classical forms in the Lane material have rare, attributed, or explicitly doubtful readings; those qualifications are retained in the relevant definitions or ledger notes.
Lane's historical Quran citation notation is not used here as a modern verse location; Quran locations are taken from the supplied QAC occurrences.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: lane-unit:Eqb:4052:g1:sub3 contains an unresolved zoological identification for يَعْقُوب: the discussion allows a partridge-related reading but also proposes an eagle interpretation.
